description: This file implements cryptographic random number generation functions, including reseeding and generating random values of various sizes, with fallback mechanisms for different platforms and configurations.

methods.name: Reseed
methods.description: Reseeds the random number generator, using platform-specific methods and fallback to legacy random functions if necessary.

methods.name: Random
methods.description: Overloaded functions to generate random values of types uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, and uint64_t, using secure sockets if enabled, or fallback to platform-specific random functions.
